name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2003 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2003 record supports: the 28 CERT/CC advisories CA-2003-01 to CA-2003-28 (Slammer, the weak-password SMB compromises of CA-2003-08, the exploited IIS WebDAV flaw, the public DCOM RPC exploits and Blaster) and the incident notes IN-2003-01 to IN-2003-04 (Mimail, Sobig.F and the Internet Explorer exploitation), Microsoft's MS02-039 and MS03-026, the Debian project's report on its November compromise, Poulsen's account of Slammer at Davis-Besse, and the Justice Department's 2003 releases (Racine, Amato, Zezev, Ivanov, Jiang, Carlson, Wiggs, Baas, the Lowe's wireless intrusion and the Weaknees DDoS case). No 2003 source prints an ATT&CK id: every entry is this study's later mapping. The Regin and Equation techniques are left out because ATT&CK draws them from later platforms, not a dated 2003 event. The Davis-Besse techniques are in the separate ATT&CK for ICS layer navigator/case-studies/chronicle-2003-ics.json. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2003.md. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
